title: Enhanced Spyglass Tool is Here!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of the enhanced Spyglass tool, now offering powerful new insights and capabilities to everyone.

title: Dynamic File Control and Display
summary: Gain complete control over your content with enhanced file management, allowing you to easily upload, download, remove, and tailor the visual presentation of all embedded files directly within your editor for a truly polished look.

title: Our New Public Roadmap is Here!
summary: Stay informed with our new public roadmap, offering clear insights into completed updates, current priorities, and exciting future developments.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for effortless task management.

title: Seamless Collaboration Experience
summary: Empower your team with a significantly upgraded collaboration experience, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: Unleash the power of collaboration with effortlessly shared ideas and instant discovery of relevant content from your network.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we expand support to include a diverse array of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open source Noeko, empowering our community with unprecedented control, transparency, and direct involvement in its exciting future development.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflow with an enhanced Constellation view, featuring powerful new filtering options and seamless integration with your shared items.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Uncover exactly what you need with powerful new filters and save your refined search results as personalized collections for quick access to your most relevant knowledge.

title: Smarter Content Linking
summary: Effortlessly structure your ideas with enhanced, interactive linking that adapts to your workflow.

title: Noeko Everywhere: Self-Host and Scale Your Vision
summary: Soon, you will have the flexibility to host Noeko on your own infrastructure, combined with new premium plans that unlock powerful features and scalability for your projects.

title: Enhanced Themes and New Styles
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual refresh as we perfect our existing themes and introduce exciting new styles to personalize your experience.

title: Personalized Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience by ensuring our greetings perfectly match the time of day, making every interaction more personal.

title: Quickly Manage Your Tags and Content
summary: Efficiently organize your ideas, quests, and sources by unapplying tags and performing other essential bulk actions directly from any tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly import and analyze a wider range of content, such as YouTube videos, websites, and plain text, to consolidate all your insights.
